verdict.rationale: Jira's own docs say users can build custom automations, including AI-assisted ones via Rovo, such as automated reminders and rules that move work forward. They also say automation keeps Jira up to date "so you don't have to" and can automatically assign tasks, which covers the core of background, autonomous automation. The evidence is marketing-level only, so it shows the capability exists but says little about its depth. Missing for 10: detailed docs on triggers, schedules and execution limits for background rules; independent or hands-on confirmation that automations run reliably without a user present.
